paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is currently 6.26, with a change of -2.27% compared to the prior close and 3.39% over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines indicate that Fermi has received a subpoena from a US District Court for documents related to the Project Matador data center campus, which has led to a decline in the stock price. The news articles from Seeking Alpha, Blockonomi, and Seeking Alpha on MSN all report on this development, with Blockonomi noting heavy insider selling pressure.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, as well as an 8-K form announcing the appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer, Lee McIntire, with an annualized base salary of $750,000. Additionally, there has been one Form 4 filing and 12 proxy solicitation filings in the feed.
